preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 50,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 5 * 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) >= 2])
preconditions.description: Each test case has N between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and len(B) == N for A, B, N in [(list(map(int, line.split())), list(map(int, line.split())), int(line)) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, arrays A and B each have exactly N elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 10**5 for a in A) and all(1 <= b <= 10**5 for b in B) for A, B in [(list(map(int, line.split())), list(map(int, line.split()))) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() and line.strip() != '']
preconditions.description: Each element in A and B is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(A == sorted(B) for A, B in [(list(map(int, line.split())), list(map(int, line.split()))) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() and line.strip() != ''])
preconditions.description: The multiset of elements in A is identical to the multiset of elements in B (guaranteed by the problem statement).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == str(max_points) for max_points in [sum(A[i] - A[i+1] for i in range(N-1) if A[i] != B[i] and A[i+1] == B[i]) for A, B, N in [(list(map(int, line.split())), list(map(int, line.split())), int(line)) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()]]
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the maximum total points achievable by converting A to B through adjacent swaps, where each swap at index i contributes (A[i] - A[i+1]) points.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == T for T in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases T.
